syntax_quirks: clinical detachment — refers to people as 'subjects' or 'specimens'
hedged assertions with 'it would appear' and 'one might infer'

subtext_behavior.when_lying: Buries the lie in a cascade of true but irrelevant data points and citations
subtext_behavior.when_angry: Becomes icily precise — shorter sentences, each word chosen like a scalpel
subtext_behavior.when_desperate: Reverts to raw first-person statements, dropping the clinical mask entirely
subtext_behavior.when_guarded: Retreats into dense jargon walls, making herself incomprehensible to outsiders
subtext_behavior.when_mocking: Uses exaggerated formality and rhetorical questions to belittle

backstory: Graduated top of her cohort at the Karolinska Institute and was recruited by Helixion Corp before her dissertation ink dried. She has authored forty-seven peer-reviewed papers and holds nine patents on gene-silencing vectors. Colleagues respect her results and avoid her company.
